features.scope: Complete pinned AlkitabModel and AlkitabYes2 production modules, all 3 unchanged Kotlin and 37 Java sources. Korrust selected production Kotlin without fallback; real release AARs, all class ABI/JVM verification, independent Java/Kotlin consumers, 19 original Yes2 tests and strict warning-free actual AGP D8 generation.
